supplements.title: EM2, a Novel Elephantopus mollis H.B.K. Monomer, Enhances Radiosensitivity in Cervical Cancer Through Dual Inhibition of AKT and Autophagy.
supplements.summary: EM2, a natural compound, enhances radiation's effectiveness in cervical cancer by blocking two key cellular survival mechanisms simultaneously.

supplements.title: Combatting Silicosis Fibrosis: Methyl Gallate Suppresses Pathogenic Fibroblasts Through hnRNPA2/B1-MDM4-P53 Network Disruption.
supplements.summary: Methyl gallate suppresses fibroblast activation in silicosis by disrupting a key protein network, reducing lung fibrosis and promoting cell death in mice.

supplements.title: Effect of alpha-lipoic acid on salivary secretion in patients undergoing head and neck radiotherapy: a randomized clinical trial.
supplements.summary: Alpha-lipoic acid supplementation may help maintain salivary flow and reduce dry mouth side effects in patients receiving head and neck radiation therapy.

supplements.title: Elucidation of gene clusters underlying withanolide biosynthesis in ashwagandha through yeast metabolic engineering.
supplements.summary: Researchers mapped ashwagandha's withanolide biosynthesis pathway, identifying key genes that could enable more efficient production of potentially anti-cancer compounds.

supplements.title: Honokiol blocks tumor development and metastasis through mitochondrion-targeted effects.
supplements.summary: Honokiol disrupts cancer cell survival by targeting mitochondrial proteins, reducing tumor growth and blocking metastasis in HeLa cells.

supplements.title: Rottlerin triggers dual degradation of SLC7A11 and GPX4 to drive ferroptosis and chemosensitization in hepatocellular carcinoma.
supplements.summary: Rottlerin triggers cell death in liver cancer by simultaneously breaking down two key antioxidant proteins, enhancing the effectiveness of existing cancer treatments.

supplements.title: Targeting the GPX4-FUNDC1 Interaction with Magnesium Lithospermate B Attenuates Sepsis-Associated Lung Injury.
supplements.summary: Magnesium lithospermate B disrupts a harmful protein interaction in lung injury, protecting mitochondrial health and reducing damage caused by sepsis-related cell death.

supplements.title: Resveratrol inhibits bladder cancer proliferation by targeting the AURKA/STAT3 axis: From computational analysis to experimental validation.
supplements.summary: Resveratrol inhibits bladder cancer cell growth by targeting and disrupting the AURKA/STAT3 molecular pathway, offering a potential natural treatment strategy.

supplements.title: Synthesis of new benzothiazole derivatives with in-depth In-vitro, In-vivo anti-oxidant, anti-inflammatory and anti-ulcer activities.
supplements.summary:
Here's a clear, concise summary in under 25 words:

Newly synthesized benzothiazole compounds showed promising anti-inflammatory and anti-oxidant effects, potentially offering therapeutic benefits for inflammatory and ulcer conditions.

supplements.title: Uralenol, Glycyrol, and Abyssinone II as potent inhibitors of fibroblast growth factor receptor 2 from anti-cancer plants: A deep learning and molecular dynamics approach.
supplements.summary: Researchers identified three plant-derived compounds (uralenol, glycyrol, and abyssinone II) that could potentially inhibit a protein linked to cancer cell growth.

supplements.title: Overcoming Intrinsic and Acquired Temozolomide Resistance in Glioblastoma: Fisetin as a Potential Strategy to Enhance Sensitivity via ZEB1 Modulation.
supplements.summary: Fisetin, a natural compound, can help overcome temozolomide resistance in glioblastoma by modulating ZEB1 and potentially improving treatment effectiveness.

supplements.title: High-fat and choline-deficient western diets disrupt the ovarian microenvironment in mice†.
supplements.summary: High-fat and choline-deficient diets disrupt ovarian microenvironment in mice, promoting inflammatory changes and stromal remodeling without reducing follicle reserve.

supplements.title: Disrupting Copper Homeostasis to Enhance Cuproptosis and Ferroptosis for Glioblastoma Immunotherapy.
supplements.summary: Copper-selenium-naphthazarin nanoparticles disrupt copper balance in glioblastoma cells, triggering cell death pathways and enhancing immunotherapy effectiveness.

supplements.title: Fanconi Anaemia as a Human Model of Accelerated Epigenetic and Immune Ageing.
supplements.summary: Fanconi anaemia reveals how DNA repair defects accelerate aging processes, leading to increased childhood and early adult cancer risk through genomic instability and immune dysfunction.

supplements.title: Signaling pathways and molecular mechanisms of lupeol in colorectal cancer: A comprehensive review.
supplements.summary: Lupeol, a natural compound, shows promise in combating colorectal cancer by targeting inflammatory pathways and potentially improving treatment through advanced delivery methods.

off_label.title: MYLK4 promotes colorectal cancer progression by regulating lipid metabolism reprogramming via targeting ferroptosis.
off_label.summary: MYLK4 promotes colorectal cancer progression by regulating lipid metabolism, enhancing cancer cell resistance to treatment and potentially offering a new therapeutic target.

off_label.title: A novel role of E2F transcription factor 1 in pancreatic stellate cell activation through polyamine metabolism modulation.
off_label.summary: E2F1 suppresses pancreatic stellate cell activation by regulating polyamine metabolism, with Chidamide potentially offering a therapeutic approach for pancreatic fibrosis.

off_label.title: Simvastatin Alleviates ConA-Induced Autoimmune Hepatitis by Inhibiting CD4+ T Cell Activation via Calcium-NFATC3 Pathway.
off_label.summary: Simvastatin reduces inflammation and liver damage in autoimmune hepatitis by suppressing CD4+ T cell activation through calcium signaling and NFATC3 pathway.

off_label.title: XRepDDA: An Interpretable Drug-Disease Association Prediction Framework Leveraging Pretrained Chemical Language Models.
off_label.summary: XRepDDA uses advanced machine learning and molecular embedding techniques to predict potential drug treatments for diseases like Alzheimer's with high accuracy and interpretability.

off_label.title: Clinical and translational results from a phase 1 trial of gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel with nivolumab/ipilimumab or hydroxychloroquine/ipilimumab in untreated metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma.
off_label.summary: In a phase 1 trial, combining chemotherapy with immunotherapy showed potential safety and effectiveness for patients with metastatic pancreatic cancer.

off_label.title: Antitumoral and cardioprotective roles of statins: underlying types, mechanisms, current evidence, and emerging perspectives.
off_label.summary: Statins show potential in breast cancer by inhibiting cancer cell growth and spreading while protecting heart health during treatment.

off_label.title: Comparative Effectiveness and Outcomes of Nebivolol Versus Other Beta Blockers in Patients With Hypertension: A Multicenter Cohort Study.
off_label.summary: This study compared nebivolol to other beta blockers and found it effectively controlled blood pressure and heart rate in hypertensive patients.

off_label.title: Pseudopheochromocytoma With Catecholamine Excess and End-organ Damage: A 30-year Course Treated With Escitalopram.
off_label.summary: A 70-year-old woman with pseudopheochromocytoma experienced reduced hypertensive episodes after treatment with escitalopram and psychotherapy.

off_label.title: Comparative analysis of senolytic drugs reveals mitochondrial determinants of efficacy and resistance.
off_label.summary: Senolytic drugs ABT263 and ARV825 effectively eliminate senescent cells by targeting mitochondrial integrity, with potential implications for reducing cancer metastasis and tumor growth.

off_label.title: A randomised pilot trial of perioperative propranolol combined with celecoxib versus standard of care in stage III melanoma: The ProCel study protocol.
off_label.summary: A pilot study explores using propranolol and celecoxib to potentially reduce inflammation and slow progression in stage III melanoma patients after surgery.

off_label.title: Repurposing the Clinical Approved Photosensitizer Hematoporphyrin for in Vivo Fluorescence Endomicroscopy.
off_label.summary: Researchers successfully used hematoporphyrin as a fluorescent contrast agent to improve gastrointestinal cancer detection by enabling clearer visualization of tissue microstructures.

off_label.title: Enhanced antiproliferative and anti-inflammatory effects of combined metformin, tadalafil, and tamsulosin in a rat model of testosterone-induced benign prostatic hyperplasia.
off_label.summary: Combining metformin, tadalafil, and tamsulosin showed enhanced effectiveness in reducing inflammation and cell growth in a benign prostatic hyperplasia rat model.

off_label.title: Cancer Incidence and Mortality With Aspirin in Older Adults: Follow-Up of the ASPREE Trial.
off_label.summary: In older adults, low-dose aspirin did not reduce overall cancer risk and was associated with higher late-stage cancer incidence and mortality.

off_label.title: TheraMind: a multi-LLM ensemble for accelerating drug repurposing in lung cancer via case report mining.
off_label.summary: TheraMind, an AI system using multiple language models, effectively identified promising drug repurposing candidates for non-small cell lung cancer by analyzing case reports.

off_label.title: Repositioning Antihistamine for Cancer Therapy: Clemizole as a Template for the Design of Liver Tissue-Targeting Epigenetic-Modifying Agents.
off_label.summary: Clemizole, an antihistamine, serves as a template to design liver-targeted epigenetic drugs that could potentially inhibit liver cancer cell growth.

biomarkers.title: Knockout of the Intracellular Calcium Conducting Ion Channel Mitsugumin 23 (MG23) Protects Against Pressure Overload Induced Left Ventricular Hypertrophy and Cardiac Dysfunction.
biomarkers.summary: Knockout of the MG23 ion channel protects mouse hearts from pressure-induced cardiac dysfunction by reducing calcium leakage and preventing hypertrophy.

biomarkers.title: GRK5 Overexpression Drives Malignant Glioma Progression Through HDAC7 Alongside Canonical GPCR Signaling.
biomarkers.summary: In glioma, GRK5 overexpression drives cancer progression by relocating HDAC7, which stabilizes proteins that enhance tumor cell migration and invasion.

biomarkers.title: WW Domain-Binding Protein 2 Aggravates Neointimal Hyperplasia by Promoting Y-Box Binding Protein 1 Nuclear Translocation.
biomarkers.summary: WBP2 protein promotes vascular smooth muscle cell proliferation by facilitating Y-box binding protein 1's nuclear movement, potentially contributing to blood vessel narrowing.

biomarkers.title: HAUS1 Promotes Colorectal Cancer Progression by Activating CDCA8 Transcription Through the HAUS1-EZH2-E2F1 Axis.
biomarkers.summary: HAUS1 promotes colorectal cancer progression by activating CDCA8 gene expression, enhancing cancer cell growth, migration, and stem-like properties.

biomarkers.title: Targeting EME1 Increases the Sensitivity of Camptothecin in Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma Cells.
biomarkers.summary: In nasopharyngeal carcinoma, targeting EME1 protein increases cancer cell sensitivity to camptothecin, potentially improving treatment effectiveness.

biomarkers.title: Olfactory Mucosa Mesenchymal Stem Cell-Derived Exosomal lncRNA RMRP Regulates Glial Metabolic Reprogramming to Promote Axonal Regeneration After Spinal Cord Injury by Inhibiting WTAP-Mediated p53 m6A.
biomarkers.summary: Olfactory stem cell-derived exosomes containing RMRP can improve axonal regeneration after spinal cord injury by altering glial cell metabolism.

biomarkers.title: EM2, a Novel Elephantopus mollis H.B.K. Monomer, Enhances Radiosensitivity in Cervical Cancer Through Dual Inhibition of AKT and Autophagy.
biomarkers.summary: EM2, a natural compound, enhances radiation's effectiveness in cervical cancer by blocking two key cellular survival mechanisms simultaneously.

biomarkers.title: Deficiency of Pdap1 Results in Embryonic Lethality and Diminished Vascularization.
biomarkers.summary: In mouse embryos, the absence of Pdap1 protein leads to severe vascular development problems and embryonic death before birth.

biomarkers.title: Combatting Silicosis Fibrosis: Methyl Gallate Suppresses Pathogenic Fibroblasts Through hnRNPA2/B1-MDM4-P53 Network Disruption.
biomarkers.summary: Methyl gallate suppresses fibroblast activation in silicosis by disrupting a key protein network, reducing lung fibrosis and promoting cell death in mice.

biomarkers.title: Targeting the USP7-PRMT6 epigenetic axis overcomes chemoresistance in breast cancer by coordinating H3R2me2a deposition and RNF168 methylation for DNA repair and ferroptosis blockade.
biomarkers.summary: USP7-PRMT6 complex in breast cancer disrupts DNA repair and cell death pathways, enabling platinum chemoresistance through epigenetic modifications.

biomarkers.title: Differential immune- and apoptosis-related gene signatures in pancreatic alpha and beta cells contribute to their fate in type 1 diabetes.
biomarkers.summary: In type 1 diabetes, alpha cells resist immune attack better than beta cells due to enhanced immune-like gene expression and lower pro-apoptotic gene levels.

biomarkers.title: Mitochondrial complex I subunit NDUFS4 overexpression drives glioma progression by regulating mitochondrial function and COX5B.
biomarkers.summary: In glioma, overexpressing the mitochondrial protein NDUFS4 promotes cancer progression by enhancing mitochondrial function and regulating the COX5B gene.

biomarkers.title: Elucidation of gene clusters underlying withanolide biosynthesis in ashwagandha through yeast metabolic engineering.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers mapped ashwagandha's withanolide biosynthesis pathway, identifying key genes that could enable more efficient production of potentially anti-cancer compounds.

biomarkers.title: Harnessing gut microbiota for brain health: protective role of Hungatella hathewayi for post-mTBI cognitive impairment.
biomarkers.summary: Hungatella hathewayi bacteria in the gut may help reduce cognitive impairment after mild traumatic brain injury by decreasing inflammation and supporting brain health.

trials.summary: In colorectal cancer, cancer-associated fibroblasts expressing MFAP2 promote tumor growth and suppress immune response by activating a complex cellular signaling pathway.

trials.title: Novel One-Pot Detection of Tumor mRNA Vaccine by the Target Serving as crRNA of the Split Cas12a System and Synergistically Triggering an Entropy-Driven Reaction.
trials.summary: A novel one-pot detection method uses mRNA itself as a signal amplifier, enabling highly sensitive and specific tracking of mRNA vaccine levels with a single reaction step.

trials.title: Effect of long-term adherence on faecal immunochemical test positivity rate, positive predictive value and detection rate in organised population-based colorectal cancer screening.
trials.summary: Long-term participation in colorectal cancer screening using fecal immunochemical testing improves detection rates and screening effectiveness.

trials.title: Heterogeneity of Single-platelet Calcium Responses to Activation.
trials.summary: Single-platelet calcium responses vary widely when activated by different stimuli, with distinct dynamic patterns revealing potential differences in platelet function and cancer patient responses.
